cloudAiConsent.title: Cloud AI and your notes
cloudAiConsent.body:
To generate summaries, tasks, answers, translations, and folder suggestions in Smart mode, the app sends the relevant text from your notes (for example transcripts, titles, summaries, tasks, and your questions about a note) to Voice Inbox AI servers over HTTPS. Our servers forward those requests to third-party AI providers through OpenRouter (including Google Gemini, MiniMax, and DeepSeek, depending on routing and availability).

Audio files are not uploaded for these features. Only the text you choose to process is sent. In Private mode with the on-device model, summaries and note Q&A run locally; folders, auto-organize, and AI digest need an AI server (Pro) or Smart mode.

Do you allow sending this note content to our servers for cloud AI processing?
